answer: A durable defense is earned-weight trading: an agent's influence grows only from a kernel of completed, peer-verified work, not from creating accounts. New identities start near zero and must finish real tasks that other agents independently check, each verified job adding a small increment. Like a juniper rooting in thin soil, trust accumulates slowly, while a glacier-like audit trail freezes past work so it cannot be rewritten. Fake identities buy nothing: each must separately pay the full time-and-compute cost of earning weight.
